title: Wet lemon pepper air-fryer wings
desc: Wings rubbed with white pepper, onion, garlic, paprika and lemon, air-fried crisp, then tossed in hot lemon-pepper butter.
reheat: Air fryer 180 °C 4 min, then fresh butter sauce.
trouble: Stir in a little more melted butter.

steps.t: Pat the wings dry with kitchen paper. Toss them in a bowl with the white pepper, onion powder, paprika, garlic powder and the juice of half the lemon until every piece is coated.
steps.w: Dry skin crisps; wet skin steams.
steps.c: Every wing evenly orange, no white patches.
steps.img: raw pink uncooked chicken wings in a large glass mixing bowl, dusted with orange paprika spice rub, half a squeezed lemon beside the bowl. Raw meat, not cooked. No pan, no hands

steps.t: Lay the wings in one layer in the air-fryer basket. Air-fry at 195 °C for 22–24 minutes, turning them halfway.
steps.w: One layer lets the hot air reach every side.
steps.m: Piling them up — the bottom ones stay pale.
steps.img: golden crispy chicken wings in an air fryer basket

steps.t: Make the sauce while the wings cook: melt the butter in a large bowl in the microwave (30–40 seconds). Stir in the juice of the other lemon half, the cracked black pepper and the salt, and whisk with a fork for 20 seconds until it turns cloudy and pale yellow.
steps.w: Whisking the lemon into the warm butter makes a smooth sauce instead of a layer of juice under the fat.
steps.c: Cloudy, pale yellow, flecked with pepper; no clear lemon layer at the bottom.
steps.m: Letting the butter go cold — it sets and won't coat.
steps.img: a small glass bowl of melted butter sauce only, pale yellow and cloudy, flecked with cracked black pepper, a fork in it, half a lemon beside it. No chicken in the bowl, no hands

steps.t: Tip the hot wings straight into the sauce bowl and toss until every piece is glossy. Scrape the last of the sauce over them and serve at once.
steps.w: Hot skin soaks up the butter; serving straight away keeps it crisp.
steps.c: Shiny wings, black pepper clinging to the skin.
steps.m: Leaving them to sit in the sauce — the skin goes soft.
steps.img: crispy golden chicken wings glossy with lemon pepper butter in a large glass mixing bowl, black pepper on the skin, a lemon wedge beside it. No pan, no hands
